hero.my_job: Full Stack Developer & UI-UX Designer From Rabat Morocco - 34.0209° N - 6.8416° W
hero.my_bio: I'm a passionate Full Stack Developer and UI-UX Designer from Morocco, skilled in creating visually appealing and functional web solutions. I’m self-taught and continuously growing through real-world projects and online learning. I enjoy solving problems, building user-centered designs, and collaborating with others. Every project I take on reflects my dedication to quality, creativity, and impactful results.

process.title: My Process
process.subtitle: I follow a structured process to ensure every project runs smoothly. From discovery to delivery, each step is carefully planned. This way, your goals turn into a successful, finished product.

items.title: Discovery
items.description: I start by understanding your business goals, target audience, and project requirements. I research competitors and gather insights to define clear objectives. This step ensures alignment on vision and expected outcomes. It sets a strong foundation for a successful project.

items.title: Planning
items.description: I create detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and deliverables. I design wireframes and user flows to visualize functionality. Technical requirements and resources are identified. This ensures a smooth and organized development process.

items.title: Design
items.description: I create visually appealing and user-friendly designs that match your brand. High-fidelity mockups and prototypes are developed. Usability and accessibility are prioritized. Feedback is incorporated to refine the final design.

items.title: Development
items.description: I implement the project using clean and efficient code. Frontend and backend components are integrated seamlessly. APIs and databases are connected and optimized. Functionality is tested as development progresses.

items.title: Testing
items.description: I thoroughly test the product for bugs, usability, and performance. User experience and responsiveness are verified. Feedback is addressed promptly. The goal is a polished and reliable final product.

items.title: Delivery & Support
items.description: I deliver the final product along with documentation if needed. Ongoing support and updates are provided. I ensure smooth operation and client satisfaction. Questions and issues are addressed promptly.

contact.title: Ready to Create?
contact.subtitle: Let’s turn your vision into reality. With my expertise in design and development, I craft solutions that blend creativity, usability, and functionality. Every project is built with care and precision to help your brand stand out and achieve real results.

about_me.name: Hi I'm Abderrahim Abid.
about_me.title: Full-Stack Developer & UI-UX Designer
about_me.description: I am a passionate full-stack developer and UI-UX designer with a keen eye for detail and a love for creating intuitive user experiences. My expertise spans across front-end and back-end technologies, allowing me to build robust and scalable web applications. I thrive on challenges and continuously seek to improve my skills in the ever-evolving tech landscape.

items.title: Experience
description: UI/UX Design: Collaborated with ALX Ventures on the 2pi startup (founded by Nabile Makbol), delivering user-focused design and product prototypes.
Full-Stack Development: Currently providing end-to-end solutions for clients, blending clean design with functional development.

items.title: Education
description: High School: Earned a High School Diploma in Physics Science from Morocco, which built a strong foundation in problem-solving, analytical thinking, and technical skills.

ALX Programs: Completed the Professional Foundations Program and the AI Career Essentials Program, and participated in the ALX Gig at a Startup (2pi, 2024), gaining hands-on experience in real-world product development.
IBM SkillsBuild Certifications: Completed certifications in Web Developer Fundamentals, User Experience Design Fundamentals, Exploring Emerging Technologies, and Cybersecurity Fundamentals.

items.title: Additional
description: Languages & Tools: Proficient in C, Python, JavaScript, SQL, MongoDB, and Bash, with hands-on experience using Git, GitHub, and VS Code. Skilled in collaborative tools such as Figma and Canva.
Design & Databases: Strong background in UI/UX and visual design using Figma, Canva. Experienced with relational and non-relational databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
Professional & Soft Skills: Known for clear communication, adaptability, reliability, and creative thinking, with the ability to work effectively in diverse teams and dynamic environments.

connect.title: Contact With Me
connect.subtitle: Do you have a question, an idea, or a project you’d like to discuss? I’m available to offer guidance, share insights, or collaborate on creative solutions. Feel free to reach out anytime for advice, feedback, or professional services. Let’s connect and work together to turn your vision into something exceptional and impactful.
